title: raphanistrum raphanistrum
intro: Raphanistrum raphanistrum, commonly known as Wild Radish, is a biennial herb belonging to the Brassicaceae family. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include its potential health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. Its therapeutic actions include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and exhibiting immune-modulating effects. Bioactive constituents of Raphanistrum raphanistrum include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
